output_list.code: function setPrices(uint256 newSellPrice, uint256 newBuyPrice) onlyOwner {     sellPrice = newSellPrice;     buyPrice = newBuyPrice;   }
output_list.reason: The prices for buying and selling are directly controlled by the contract owner. This can lead to an unfair advantage for the owner in the buy/sell transactions. Also, if the owner loses control of the contract, the prices will be locked forever.
